title: Names

questions.question: Is it easy to remember people’s names?
questions.sampleAnswer: To be honest, I’d say it is quite easy for me, because I try to connect a name with something about the person, like their job or their face. That little trick makes it stick in my mind much better.

questions.question: How do you remember people’s names?
questions.sampleAnswer: What I usually do is repeat the name a few times in my head, and I also connect it to something about the person, like their job or appearance. That helps me remember it much better.

questions.question: How do you feel when people can’t remember your name?
questions.sampleAnswer: Well, I wouldn’t take it personally. I think it’s perfectly normal to forget names, because everyone meets so many people. As long as they make an effort later, I’m fine with it.

questions.question: Do you often forget people’s names?
questions.sampleAnswer: I’d say I do forget them quite often, especially when I meet a lot of new people at once. So I usually try to use the name right away to fix it in my memory.
